Patch Set 2:

(3 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. Everything except lproc_osc.c is provably formatting-only (string literals are byte-identical after concatenation), but the seq_printf() -> seq_puts() conversions do change the rendered output. checkpatch.pl's PREFER_SEQ_PUTS fixup strips `%%` from the format string before deciding it has no conversion specifiers, so its --fix-inplace result needs a hand check on any string containing `%%`.
